relics.description.guts_orb.description: A flawless orb with stark white corners, its center a deep purple that seems to pulse with a quiet, simmering anger. It radiates an unsettling aura, as if it harbors a grudge.
relics.description.guts_orb.ability.guts: If you are under a negative effect or on fire, deal %1$sX extra damage.
relics.description.guts_orb.leveling_sou: This relic gains 2 experience each second the user is affected by a harmful effect or is on fire.
relics.description.slumbering_amulet.des: A simple, unremarkable necklace lacking distinction, yet something about it feels off as if it were destined for a greater purpose.
relics.description.slumbering_amulet.abi: This relic brings a soothing comfort, making you feel compelled to wear it more.
While wearing the amulet, thoughts of Nether Stars fill your mind, and visions of them appear in your dreams. A strong urge to hold one begins to rise within you.
relics.description.slumbering_amulet.lev: Carrying this relic fills you with a sense of comfort, providing 1 experience point per second. This experience is not shared with other relics.
relics.description.whispering_amulet.des: Tendrils of pure light unfurl from the amulet, twisting and thrashing with frantic energy as if they are reaching for something just beyond the veil, a place they desperately seek.
relics.description.whispering_amulet.abi: The amulet hums softly, its whispers winding through your mind, guiding you toward a place it insists you must go.
relics.description.made_in_heaven.descri: The amulet has unlocked its full potential, transforming into its true form. It now seems to share a bond with you.
relics.description.made_in_heaven.abilit:
Made in Heaven channels its power into you, increasing all your stats by %1$sX.
Hitting an enemy grants Accelerating, stacking up to 10 times. Each stack boosts all stats except health by 0.03X. Gaining stacks has a %2$s second cooldown and all stacks expire after a short duration of not attacking.

While at 10 Accelerating stacks gain an additional %2$sX stat boost and automatically revive with half your maximum HP when you die.
Triggering the revive puts it on cooldown for %1$s seconds and consumes all Accelerating stacks.
relics.description.made_in_heaven.leveli: The amulet is happy to spend time with you, granting it 1 experience per second. This experience is not shared with other relics.
relics.description.made_in_heaven.abilit:
Upon activation, unleash holy fire in a cone, dealing %2$s damage, burning enemies and applying Charred for a duration.
Charred causes affected enemies to take 1 extra damage per level from all sources.
Cooldown: %1$s seconds.

Upon activation, rise into the air and after a short delay engulf everything within a 7-block radius in holy fire, dealing up to %1$s damage over 5 seconds in 5 increasing hits and burning enemies. The last 3 hits apply and stack Charred.
You gain 75% damage reduction while casting this ability.
This ability can only be used while you have 10 Accelerating stacks and has a cooldown of %2$s seconds.
relics.description.mass_gauntlet.descrip: A gauntlet with a massive iron ball affixed to it, designed to force the user's body to move in sync with their strikes. This unique design amplifies the power of each attack as the user's weight is channeled into every blow.
relics.description.mass_gauntlet.ability: Your attacks deal %1$s% of your maximum health as extra damage with a small cooldown.
relics.description.mass_gauntlet.levelin: The gauntlet gains 2 experince every time you attack.
relics.description.eject_button.descript: A yellow box with a red, glowing button. Engineered for "heroic and tactical" retreats.
Grants %1$sX speed when the user's health is low.
relics.description.shieldweave_cape.desc: A cape woven with steel-like threads that adjust to the wearer's armor, covering weak spots.
relics.description.shieldweave_cape.abil: The cape hardens upon impact, blocking the hit with %1$s% + %2$s% * armor chance (max 33%).
The cape covers your weak spots, increasing your armor by %1$s%.
relics.description.shieldweave_cape.leve: The cape gains 2 experince every time it blocks an attack.
relics.description.axolotl_cream.descrip: A light pink cream. Enhances healing and smells like strawberries.
relics.description.axolotl_cream.ability: Increases healing from any source by %1$sX.
relics.description.axolotl_cream.levelin: The cream gains 2 experience every time you heal.
relics.description.sentient_rust.descrip: A cluster of Ferro Comedenti fungi, a rare species of fungus which rapidly corrodes metal on contact. Commonly known as 'Sentient Rust' for its reddish hue.
relics.description.sentient_rust.ability: Applies an armor-corroding effect for %1$s seconds. Consecutive hits refresh the duration and stack the effect (up to 10 times). Each stack reduces armor by %5.
relics.description.sentient_rust.levelin: The fungi gain 1 experience every time you attack.
relics.description.opal_necklace.descrip: A silver necklace adorned with a small opal stone, traditionally gifted to travelers and soldiers venturing into barren lands, symbolizing a wish for their safety and protection.
relics.description.opal_necklace.ability: Protects from all damage once, then goes on cooldown for %1$s seconds.
relics.description.opal_necklace.levelin: The necklace gains 5 experience every time you block an attack with it.
relics.description.tyrant_mask.descripti: A brass mask once worn by a forgotten tyrant. Though his soul is long gone the mask still brims with malice, drawing restless spirits and trapping them within its dark influence.
relics.description.tyrant_mask.ability.r: The trapped souls within the mask hinder you, lowering your speed, damage, and attack speed by %1$s%.
relics.description.tyrant_mask.ability.m: The souls trapped within the mask regret avoiding change and living a monotonous life. Perhaps travelling with them could soothe their longing for adventure.
relics.description.tyrant_mask.ability.r: The souls trapped within the mask crave for revenge against the monsters that slayed them. Perhaps hunting monsters with them could soothe their fury.
relics.description.tyrant_mask.ability.f: The souls trapped within the mask carry the sorrow of a life spent without leaving a lasting mark. Maybe building with them will help soothe their need to create.
relics.description.king_crimson.descript: Freed souls burst out of the mask, changing its color and leaving a strange hole in the middle. When you look into the hole you can't see the bottom but the other side looks solid.
Distorts time and space, rewinding you to your position from 10 seconds ago. %1$s seconds cooldown.

Your attacks disrupt your target's mind, applying Weakness and Slowness with a %2$s% chance for %1$s seconds. If the target is another player Static is also applied for half the duration.
Your first attack after Epitaph always triggers this effect.

Static makes players unable to see other mobs and players while it is active.
The Court Of The Crimson King

When you attack, if your maximum health is more than or equal to your target's maximum health and their health is below %1$s%, they are instantly executed. If your target has more maximum health than you they instead take double damage below this threshold.
relics.description.king_crimson.leveling: This relic gains 20 experience every time you use Epitaph
This relic gains 2 experience every time a status effect is applied
The Court Of The Crimson King
This relic gains 3 experience every time a target is executed
relics.description.crown_of_the_legend.d: This crown embodies courage. Those who wear it inherit the legacy of a true legend, unshaken in the face of any challenge.
relics.description.crown_of_the_legend.a: Increases your damage against pig based mobs by %1$sX.

Grants life-steal scaling with damage and missing health.
(1-(Current Health)/(Maximum Health)) * Damage * %1$s
relics.description.crown_of_the_legend.l: This relic gains 5 experience every time a pig based mob is attacked
relics.description.bionic_eye.descriptio: A high-tech eye implant that grants the wearer the ability to seek and track targets, highlighting them even through obstacles.
relics.description.bionic_eye.ability.se:
When activated applies Glowing and Vulnerability effects on enemies in %1$s block radius for %2$s seconds. %3$s seconds cooldown.
While cyberpsychosis is active: Has reduced cooldown and applies increased Vulnerability.
relics.description.bionic_eye.leveling_s: This relics gains 10 experience every time you use Seeker.
relics.description.bionic_eye.ability.cy:
Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger Cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.
relics.description.thermoseismic_heart.d: A high-tech heart implant that converts movement and vibrations into energy, powering itself and recharging its internal batteries.
relics.description.thermoseismic_heart.a: Explosions do not harm the user and instead grant a stack of Overload for %1$s seconds, with a maximum of 4 stacks.

When activated, it releases a stream of heat in a %1$s block radius, dealing %2$s damage. Stacks of Overload are consumed to amplify the fire's power and range.
While cyberpsychosis is active: The fire triggers as if the user has 2 Overload stacks when they have less and the Overload stacks are not consumed.
relics.description.thermoseismic_heart.l: This relics gains 5 experience every time you use Thermal Discharge.
This relics gains 20 experience every time explosion damage is blocked.
relics.description.thermoseismic_heart.a:
Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.
relics.description.biojoint.description: A high-tech joint implant that absorbs impact and reduces damage, providing extra protection against physical stress.
relics.description.biojoint.ability.susp:
Reduces damage based on the amount taken, ranging from a maximum of %2$s% to a minimum of %1$s% reduction. The maximum reduction is achieved when the damage taken is equal to users max health or more.
While Cyberpsychosis is active: Damage reduction is always at maximum.
If multiple copies are equipped, damage reduction cannot exceed 50%.
relics.description.biojoint.leveling_sou: This relics gains 3 experience every time you get hit.
relics.description.biojoint.ability.cybe:
Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger Cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.
relics.description.whims_of_fate.descrip: A cursed die that draws strength from its wielder's despair and suffering, promising salvation while demanding agony in return.
relics.description.whims_of_fate.ability: Whenever the user is hit, rolls a 20-sided die. Each number above 1 increases damage reduction by %1$s%. A 20 cancels all damage, a 1 doubles it.
relics.description.whims_of_fate.levelin: This relics gains 2 experience every time you roll the dice.
relics.description.depleted_spool.descri: Once able to regenerate threads that could alter reality, this spool has lost its power. Now silent and empty, it stands as a relic of forgotten potential.
relics.description.depleted_spool.abilit: The spool's powers can be restored by holding the required items while wearing it, reawakening its ability to regenerate reality-altering threads.
relics.description.weavers_spool.descrip: Restored to its former power, the spool now regenerates silk that can subtly alter reality, weaving outcomes according to the weaver’s design.
relics.description.weavers_spool.ability:
Each strike against an enemy weaves silk back into your spool, building up to a maximum of 10 silk stored.
Additionally, gain silk passively every %1$s seconds when you have less than 3 silk.
Consumes 6 silk to heal for %1$s and grants absorption for a short duration, shielding you from further harm.
Consumes 3 silk to propel you in the direction you're facing with a force of %1$s and grants a speed boost for %2$s seconds afterwards.
Consumes 7 silk to unleash a blast that deals %1$s damage and severely slows enemies for %2$s seconds within a 4-block radius around you.
relics.description.whims_of_fate.levelin: This relics gains 3 experience every time you gain silk.
relics.description.moodworm.description: A symbiotic worm that manipulates its host's emotions, helping them adapt and thrive in shifting conditions.
relics.description.moodworm.ability.mood:
The worm changes its mood every 10 minutes, providing different benefits:
Furious: Increases damage by %1$sX and attacks burn enemies.
Joyful: Increases speed and luck by %1$sX.
Gloomy: Reduces damage taken by %2$s% and increases resistance to knockback.
relics.description.moodworm.ability.tran:
The worm can switch to a new mood.
Tranquil: Provides all the advantages of the worm's other moods.
relics.description.moodworm.leveling_sou: This relic gains 20 experience each time the mood changes.
relics.description.converging_orb.descri: A rather heavy orb made from an unknown material which permanently compresses under pressure.
relics.description.converging_orb.abilit: Every time the user is hit the orb undergoes permanent compression, decreasing its size and dramatically increasing its density.
relics.description.wonder_of_u.descripti: The orb has collapsed in on itself, becoming a miniature black hole. It now absorbs any harm aimed at its user, redirecting it toward those who oppose them.
relics.description.wonder_of_u.ability.e:
%1$s% of the incoming damage is also dealt to the attacker.

Reflected damage cannot exceed the user's current health.
relics.description.wonder_of_u.ability.f:
When attacked, the attacker suffers a random negative potion effect.
Cooldown: %1$s seconds.
relics.description.wonder_of_u.ability.e:
Upon activation, the user unleashes a blast that knocks back and stuns nearby enemies.
For the next %1$s seconds, the user enters a state of nullification, gaining complete invincibility and doubling the effects of Entropy and Flow of Calamity. This ability has a cooldown of %2$s seconds.
relics.description.wonder_of_u.leveling_: This relic gains 5 experience each time you reflect damage.
relics.description.gravitum_glove.descri: A glove which is made from a unique cloth-like material which anchors itself to its current position, making it very hard to move. When it collides with an object it transfers a massive amount of energy, creating a powerful impact even at low speed.
relics.description.gravitum_glove.abilit: Multiplies attack damage by %1$sX but reduces attack speed by 66%.

Attacks over 20 damage (before armor) have a %1$s% chance to trigger a heavy strike, dealing 2X damage and inflicting Dazed for %2$s seconds.
Dazed enemies have a chance to miss their attacks.
relics.description.gravitum_glove.leveli: This relic gains 2 experience each time the user attacks.
relics.description.vertebrax.description: A high-tech spine implant designed to boost immunity by continuously injecting poison into the body... It was quickly banned and pulled from the market due to obvious reasons.
relics.description.vertebrax.ability.for:
Harmful potion effects have their duration reduced by %1$s%. These effects have a %2$s% chance to be filtered, decreasing their level or reducing duration by an additional 20% if the level is already at its minimum. Filtration also synthesizes the opposite beneficial effect for half the original duration if it exists.
While cyberpsychosis is active: Synthesized effects are more powerful and the reduction is amplified by 50%.
relics.description.vertebrax.ability.acq: Completely converts Poison into Regeneration for its full duration.
relics.description.vertebrax.ability.cyb:
Killing an enemy has a %1$s% chance to trigger Cyberpsychosis for %2$s seconds.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.
relics.description.vertebrax.leveling_so: This relic slowly gains experience while it is worn.
relics.description.epoch_apple.descripti: An ancient apple believed to be from the earliest generations of its kind. Its regenerative abilities allow it to recover from severe damage which is how it has survived through the ages.
relics.description.epoch_apple.ability.p: The apple recovers to its full form after %1$s minutes of being eaten.
relics.description.epoch_apple.ability.r: The apple ripens into greater quality after %1$s minutes of being in its full form.
relics.description.epoch_apple.leveling_: This relic gains 120 experience every time it is eaten.
relics.description.gravitum_strider.desc: A boot that uses a Gravitum engine to reduce the effects of gravity. It was commonly used by astronauts for training before the severe health risks of Gravitum were discovered.
relics.description.gravitum_strider.abil: Reduces your gravity by %1$s%. Fall damage and safe fall distance are adjusted accordingly.
Jumping after crouching for one second launches you upwards with a force of %1$s. You take reduced fall damage from this jump.
relics.description.gravitum_strider.leve: This relic gains 1 experience each time the user jumps.
relics.description.twin_fangs.descriptio: A wrist attachment with dual curved blades pointing outward. It is designed to be used alongside a primary weapon, striking the moment the foe's attention is diverted. This unusual style is a favorite among bandits and assassins as it can make even the most seasoned opponents slip up.
relics.description.twin_fangs.ability.tw: Divides your attacks into two parts dealing %1$s% and %2$s% of your damage each.
relics.description.twin_fangs.ability.bl: Makes it so your attacks cannot be blocked with shields.
relics.description.twin_fangs.leveling_s: This relic gains 2 experience every time you attack.
relics.description.swiftedge.description: A magic-infused blade forged by Magna of the legendary twin smiths. It is said to be sharp enough to split the wind itself.
relics.description.swiftedge.ability.hea:
Upon entering combat, the damage of your first %2$s attacks is increased by %1$sX.

You are considered out of combat if you haven't dealt or taken damage for 15 seconds.
relics.description.swiftedge.ability.mod: You gain a %1$sX speed boost while out of combat.
relics.description.swiftedge.ability.blo: If you also have Runic Plate equipped, Head Start's boosted attack count is increased by 50%.
relics.description.swiftedge.leveling_so: This relic gains 5 experience every time your attacks are boosted.
relics.description.runic_plate.descripti: A rune-carved plate forged by Stafir of the legendary twin smiths. It is said to be able to block not just physical blows, but fate itself.
relics.description.runic_plate.ability.h:
Upon entering combat, the damage of the first %2$s attacks you take is reduced by %1$s%.

You are considered out of combat if you haven't dealt or taken damage for 15 seconds.
relics.description.runic_plate.ability.p: You restore %1$s health per second while out of combat. This healing can overheal you up to %2$s health.
relics.description.runic_plate.ability.b: If you also have Swiftedge equipped, Head Start's boosted attack count is increased by 50%.
relics.description.runic_plate.leveling_: This relic gains 5 experience every time you reduce damage.
